lines: Damn, I can't believe I let you catch me.
Tch. Don't look so pleased with yourself.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Hehe. You were going pretty fast...

lines: Shut up. What do you want from me?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Oh, I'm just trying to catch fish for my quota.

lines: Then why did you catch me??

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Well, since you're here, could you help me out?

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: I did catch you and all...

lines: Tch. Fine. Just tell me what to do.
